83.name: The Simpsons
83.summary: The Simpsons is the longest running scripted show in US television history. It captures the adventures of Homer, Marge, Maggie, Bart and Lisa who are living in a fictional town called Springfield.

347.name: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia
347.summary: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia is an American comedy series about four friends in their late 20s with clear sociopathic tendencies who run an unsuccessful Irish bar, "Paddy's Pub," in South Philadelphia. The series deals with a variety of controversial topics, including abortion, gun control, physical disabilities, racism, sexism, religion, the Israeli/Palestinian situation, terrorism, transse…

672.name: Phineas and Ferb
672.summary: Phineas and Ferb are Phineas Flynn and his stepbrother, Ferb Fletcher who are determined to make every day of their summer vacation fun. They try building a full-scale roller coaster, becoming musicians, building a backyard beach, and traveling back in time to meet dinosaurs. Their family pet, Perry the Platypus, doubles as a secret agent and battles evil. Meanwhile, older sister Candace is tattl…

713.name: SpongeBob SquarePants
713.summary: Come follow the adventures of the world's most lovable sponge and his starfish sidekick! Though they have the best intentions, SpongeBob and Patrick are always causing trouble… and plenty of laughs!When he's not at the Krusty Krab grilling up some epic Krabby Patties, SpongeBob can be found jellyfishing with Patrick, blowing bubbles, or annoying his favorite neighbor, Squidward!Bikini Bottom is h…

2955.name: Taskmaster
2955.summary: Greg Davies is the Taskmaster who, with the help of his right-hand man, Alex, sets out to test the wiles, wit and wisdom of five hyper competitive comedians through a series of ingenious challenges. With the chance to be crowned show champion, rivalry amongst the comedians is encouraged, dodgy tactics rewarded and bribes accepted.

33352.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
33352.summary: Set thousands of years before the events of The Lord of the Rings, this epic drama follows an ensemble cast of characters, both familiar and new, as they confront the long-feared re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth.

38052.name: Silo
38052.summary: Silo depicts a ruined and toxic future, when thousands of people live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

44458.name: Ted Lasso
44458.summary: Ted Lasso centers on an idealistic — and clueless — all-American football coach hired to manage an English football club — despite having no soccer coaching experience at all.

44776.name: Lanterns
44776.summary: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

46573.name: Ghosts
46573.summary: Samantha and Jay throw caution to the wind when they convert their recently inherited country estate into a bed-and-breakfast. Call it mislaid plans. Not only is the place falling apart, but it's also inhabited by spirits of previous residents -- whom only Samantha can see and hear. Ghosts spins the funny, heartfelt story about a newfound dream that reveals connection and self-discovery aren't ju…

47119.name: The Chosen
47119.summary: The Chosen is the first-ever-multi-season TV show about the life of Jesus. Created outside of the Hollywood system, The Chosen allows us to see Him through the eyes of those who knew him. No matter where you are at in your journey with Jesus Christ, this TV show is for you.

48108.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
48108.summary: 12-year-old modern demigod Percy Jackson has just come to terms with his newfound supernatural powers when the sky god Zeus accuses him of stealing his master lightning bolt. Now Percy must trek across America to find it and restore order to Olympus.

52343.name: Ahsoka
52343.summary: Set after the fall of the Empire, Ahsoka follows the former Jedi knight Ahsoka Tano as she investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

64950.name: VisionQuest
64950.summary: Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's so…

78665.name: Dexter: Resurrection
78665.summary: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

85255.name: Haunted Hotel
85255.summary: A single mother of two struggles to run a haunted hotel with the help of her estranged brother, who is now one of the ghosts haunting the hotel and thinks the other ghosts have some pretty good ideas.

episodes.name: You're Nice
episodes.summary: Isy Suttie unexpectedly mentions eggs, Matt Lucas stares hard at the ceiling, Nina Conti gets very clever in a test, Chloe Petts hides an object somewhere Alex Horne wouldn't dare look, and Richard Ayoade gives the slight impression that he finds some of the tasks a bit irritating. But why is Greg …

episodes.name: Diary of a Chimpy Kid
episodes.summary: Bart and Lisa adopt an abandoned baby chimp and clash over their surprisingly different parenting styles. When the chimp is abducted by a private wild animal zoo, the family goes on a mission to rescue him. Homer is conflicted about saving the ape, because he's convinced the chimp will tear off his…

episodes.name: Dirt and Stars
episodes.summary: As John and Hal draw closer to the truth, John comes to an unexpected understanding with Sheriff Kane... just as a chilling new discovery emerges.

episodes.name: Frank's Team: A Dark Day for Baseball
episodes.summary: In an effort to clean up their image, Paddy's sponsors a local Little League team. But when The Gang spots softness in their franchise, they impose a radical new culture: win no matter what and do whatever it takes to get ahead.

episodes.name: Night of the Living Candace Suits
episodes.summary: An army of Candace Suits terrorizes Danville, and it's up to Candace and Beatrice to stop them.

episodes.name: Terrors of the AltSpace
episodes.summary: Baljeet and Buford get stuck in the space between dimensions known as the AltSpace.

episodes.name: Being Alive
episodes.summary: Season finale. Big changes in bunches.

episodes.name: To Void An Oblong
episodes.summary: Isy Suttie unexpectedly mentions eggs, Matt Lucas stares hard at the ceiling, Nina Conti gets very clever in a test, Chloe Petts hides an object somewhere Alex Horne wouldn't dare look, and Richard Ayoade gives the slight impression that he finds some of the tasks a bit irritating. But why is Greg …

episodes.name: Ooze
episodes.summary: With business picking up at the Undervale, Katherine is hiring for help. But can the perfect candidate survive the hotel's frightful working conditions?

episodes.name: Dinner Party
episodes.summary: Katherine braces for an unwelcome surprise as Ben throws a hauntingly awkward dinner party for Annabelle. Esther and Abaddon's friendship is tested.

episodes.name: The Witch
episodes.summary: While Katherine and the kids reluctantly support a needy witch, Nathan struggles to open up about his afterlife and Abaddon tackles fiendish food prep.

episodes.name: Ghost Day Out
episodes.summary: Nathan discovers something to "live" for on a once-in-a-generation night when ghosts can roam free. Katherine stays in with an almost angelic Abaddon.

episodes.name: Astral Esther
episodes.summary: After an astral projection mishap, Katherine and Shayna must help Esther find her body. Nathan takes Ben and Abaddon to a mermaid-infested lake.

episodes.name: Dante Crowe
episodes.summary: Gunslinging ghosthunter Dante Crowe checks in, dragging the family into a fight against world-ending omens. Abaddon answers the call of the wild.

episodes.name: The Concierge
episodes.summary: Nathan faces the horrors of politics as Esther runs his campaign for Ghost Mayor. A multi-limbed concierge lends Katherine a hand — much to Ben's dismay.

episodes.name: The Visit
episodes.summary: To save the Undervale, Katherine must recall her first visit to the hotel, when a living Nathan offered her a place to call home amid marital struggles.

episodes.name: The Guys Have a Sleepover
episodes.summary: Blinded from LASIK surgery, Dee pleads for the guys to spend the night to keep her safe from neighborhood crime, but they listen to the wolves inside themselves and opt for a dudes-only sleepover of their own.

episodes.name: No Strings
episodes.summary: Vision embarks on a journey of self-discovery and finds himself hunted by a deadly force.

episodes.name: Theseus
episodes.summary: Vision comes face to face with his assailant while investigating whether Tommy Shepherd is his son.

episodes.name: The Oldest I've Ever Looked
episodes.summary: A former contestant makes an unexpected and dramatic return to the Taskmaster house, but will the current cast give them the respect they undoubtedly deserve?

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening
episodes.summary: All hell breaks loose on Halloween when a killer comes to Springfield and hacks their way through town. No Simpson is safe from... THE REVENGENING!

episodes.name: Reboot
episodes.summary: Vision and Tommy Shepherd join forces in order to survive while a terrifying killer strikes again.

episodes.name: Malware
episodes.summary: As Vision confronts a new enemy, Ultron and Tommy Shepherd come face to face.

episodes.name: The Unfairity
episodes.summary: Richard Ayoade causes controversy while wearing a blindfold, Isy Suttie reveals her revolutionary counting method, Nina Conti invents a new word, Matt Lucas briefly turns into an old-school railwayman, and Chloe Petts is the first contestant in Taskmaster history to draw blood while avoiding flying…

episodes.name: Treehouse of Horror XXXVII
episodes.summary: Bart and Lisa are trapped in an abandoned immersive theme park experience.

episodes.name: Firewall
episodes.summary: Ultron and Jocasta join forces. Lisa comes to Vision's aid to help him evade capture.

episodes.name: Deadlock
episodes.summary: Vision and Paladin form an uneasy alliance as Thomas finally learns the truth about his past.

episodes.name: A Very Televisual Torso
episodes.summary: Matt Lucas decides to cut the Taskmaster down to size. Nina Conti repeatedly insults a citrus fruit, and Alex Horne delights in making everyone wear aprons.

episodes.name: Halloween 6: The Mirror - Part One
episodes.summary: A couple of months after Pete's disappearance, while Sam is in Australia on the set of her new film, Polar Opposites, Kyle steps up to help baby-sit the ghosts.

episodes.name: Halloween 6: The Mirror - Part Two
episodes.summary: Hetty is unexpectedly reunited with her estranged sister, Margaret (guest star Maria Thayer), and Bela throws an unconventional Halloween bash at Woodstone.

episodes.name: Risky Business
episodes.summary: Dexter struggles to find purpose beyond the hunt as Harrison begins his NYPD career. A brazen new murderer puts the city on edge.

episodes.name: Testing 1-2-3
episodes.summary: In what she argues is not an attempt to get extra time on tests, Lisa has herself evaluated for three types of neurodiversity.. which remind her of behaviors she's witnessed in Principal Skinner, Comic Boy and Homer. Perhaps these atypical behaviors aren't as atypical as we think.

episodes.name: Big, Clumsy Emu Steps
episodes.summary: It's the grand final and there's only one question left to be answered: how much leg hair does Little Alex Horne have? No, sorry: who is the 22nd Taskmaster champion?

episodes.name: Backyard Bickering
episodes.summary: Sandy's brother, Randy sets up a wrestling ring outside the Krusty Krab to help settle everyone's arguments.

episodes.name: A Hair Grows on Patrick
episodes.summary: A hair suddenly sprouts on Patrick's head that he has trouble getting rid of.

episodes.name: Yoga Yahoos
episodes.summary: Squidward is put in charge of teaching a yoga class and is dismayed when SpongeBob and Patrick show up and continuously disrupt class.

episodes.name: Sounds Like Trouble
episodes.summary: Patrick crashes into mobster Don Scarfish, causing their voice boxes to fly out and swap.

episodes.name: Dream Scenari-Moe
episodes.summary: When Moe has trouble sleeping, he enrolls in a brand-new sleep study that gives him the greatest romantic comedy dreams of his life. But unbeknownst to him, his beautiful fantasy comes at a nightmarish price.

episodes.name: My Rescue Operation Goes Very Wrong
An Old Dead Friend Comes to Visit
Upturn's Bunch
episodes.summary: Lady Upturn is invited to learn the true meaning of friendship by joining the Gal Pals.

episodes.name: Free with Every Meal
episodes.summary: In a ruse to distract SpongeBob from guarding the secret formula, the Chum Bucket begins offering collectible jellyfish toys.

episodes.name: I Learn How to Grow Zombies
We Visit the Junkyard of the Gods
Merry Christmas Mr. Plankton
episodes.summary: SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas when Plankton takes over the North Pole.

episodes.name: I Put on A Few Million Extra Pounds
